scope: Norway medical discovery — Arctic University of Norway Faculty of Health Sciences

verifiedFacts.claim: UiT publishes a Professional Study in Medicine commencing autumn 2026 in Tromsø.
UiT states that programmes offered through central admissions require Norwegian-language qualifications.
UiT's 2026 tuition guidance lists Medicine in category 3 at NOK 351,000 annually, with the page explaining application timelines and exemptions for international applicants.
NOKUT explains that Norwegian universities have the authority to establish programmes at all levels and that quality assurance is supervised nationally.

holdReasons: No complete current Medicine programme page was established for duration, curriculum, degree award, admissions selection and clinical placements.
The central-admissions Norwegian-language requirement prevents presenting the route as generally accessible to international English-medium applicants.
A complete programme-specific recognition, accommodation and international-support packet was not completed.
nextAction: Obtain UiT's full 2026 Medicine programme and admissions documentation, then verify route-specific fee applicability, professional recognition, clinical teaching and support before packaging.
